title: Caniglia v. Strom (2021)
key_points: Holding: The community caretaking exception for vehicles does not extend to warrantless entry and seizures in the home.
officer_notes: Scenario: After a welfare check, you enter a man's home while he is away at the hospital and take his firearms 'for safety'.
Takeaway: In the home rely on a warrant, consent or a real emergency, not community caretaking.
